source_correspondence: H0 states the exact real quadratic, strict-sign, independence, nonvertical and physical-side hypotheses. It separates the phase result from the pending amplitude and weak propagation theorems.

C0 proves frequency transversality by explicit spectator Lagrangian linear algebra and a homogeneous canonical shear preserving the pair. Exact Euler-form preservation gives the boundary mixed generator and its invertible mixed Hessian.
C1 constructs the actual characteristic foliation from fixed model frequencies and an explicit homogeneous leafwise primitive, with no unproved Hamilton-Jacobi integration step.

C2 proves an actual fold in coordinates retaining q, by the positive Taylor-integral square and smooth division Qc=-vD. The target caustic and source fold are distinguished and their boundary transversality is explicit.

C3 uses complete earlier square descent and controlled extension proofs. Integrating the odd normal covector yields its exact cubic coefficient, with positive boundary normalization. The two real eikonal equations determine the minus sign and both degrees.
C4 corrects both boundary values by smooth flat wedge terms supported strictly on the unattained side. Every derivative and all caustic jets are controlled, and homogeneity is preserved.

C5 factors the actual quadratic normal equation, proves b0=mu C0 with C0 positive, and fixes both complex root signs from the actual normal orientation. Full normal-jet recursion uses only polynomial losses in |v| inverse. Flat residuals and induction prove flatness of all corrections and real desingularized jets.

C6 realizes every correcting jet by a supported smooth sum with explicit uniform derivative and flat-weight bounds. One common neighborhood gives all boundary and caustic remainder estimates; exact frequency powers are 2-|beta| and 5/3-|beta|. The mixed phase rank persists across both sides.

C7 gives an ordinary jointly degree-one cubic phase and proves independence of all critical differentials. Its characteristic covectors, both branches and the full critical value including the input term -w dot eta are verified.

X1 derives the full variable-base cotangent cross term and exact phases. X2 checks the eikonal sign. X3 identifies the characteristic center shifts and the boundary exchange. Seven finite groups give 38 exact checks; these do not substitute for the arguments.

Thirteen local proof entries bind to 393 earlier entries in eleven current maps; 102 of those are explicitly external Lebl proof providers. No internal export P514 closure is claimed. Fifteen reader captures and the entire illustration have been inspected.
